Extract markdown-aware chunks and pass their content and metadata to your retrieval system.

```elixir title="Elixir"
input_value = %Xberg.ExtractInput{kind: "uri", mime_type: "text/markdown", uri: "https://example.com/markdown/comprehensive.md"}
result = Xberg.extract_async(input_value, "{\"chunking\":{\"chunker_type\":\"markdown\",\"max_characters\":500,\"overlap\":50,\"trim\":true}}")
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.results, 0).chunks)
```
